# check_gwupshat

> A Nagios/Icinga plugin for monitoring a Geekworm UPS Hat attached to a Raspberry Pi.

The shell plugin checks battery capacity and voltage and supports configurable warning and critical thresholds.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/check_gwupshat): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/check_gwupshat/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.
